### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **36** documentable anchor(s).

**66** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 97f4f8c8282ebb78de0815cec24eddb8b8335eb0`.

⛔ **13** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sharingModel (literal, 42 pages)`
- **10** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **136** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 97f4f8c8282ebb78de0815cec24eddb8b8335eb0` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `80d28ff44b5e3e4d6422e72c388f1988a8956ff6` — the merge of head `9e6e78dd1e871028f1969863e87b20ceffd5e0a4` into base `97f4f8c8282ebb78de0815cec24eddb8b8335eb0`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 80d28ff44b5e3e4d6422e72c388f1988a8956ff6 && git checkout 80d28ff44b5e3e4d6422e72c388f1988a8956ff6
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 97f4f8c8282ebb78de0815cec24eddb8b8335eb0 9e6e78dd1e871028f1969863e87b20ceffd5e0a4 && git checkout -B drift-repro 97f4f8c8282ebb78de0815cec24eddb8b8335eb0 && git merge --no-ff 9e6e78dd1e871028f1969863e87b20ceffd5e0a4

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 97f4f8c8282ebb78de0815cec24eddb8b8335eb0
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 97f4f8c8282ebb78de0815cec24eddb8b8335eb0` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Docs drift — receipted by the seat, with the reading that says no page moves. 2026-09-22T06:29Z

`domain:spec` execution seat, on `docs-drift-check`'s comment `5772019296`. ⛔ Not a dismissal: the run's 36 anchors and 66 hand-written pages were taken as a work list and read.

**The verdict is that nothing here can falsify a page, and the reason is structural rather than a spot check:** this change moves **no schema, no accept set and no export**. It adds form ROWS to `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY` and the translated copy those rows force. Every anchor the run matched is a key NAME, and the pages under `content/docs/references/**` that carry those names are GENERATED from the schemas — unchanged here, which is also why `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:generated` reads all 15 artefacts up to date on this head.

**The one hand-written page that names the subject was read in full rather than grepped:** `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx:413-427` (「Metadata authoring forms (`metadataForms`)」). It states the MECHANISM — the type's authoring form lays out the panel, a bundle localises it under `metadataForms.<type>.fields.<key>` — and carries ⛔ no count, ⛔ no key list, ⛔ no claim about which keys have a control. A row landing under `metadataForms.object.fields.nameField` is the shape that page documents, so this change **confirms** it. Nothing to edit.

⛔ The 13 release-owned pages are read-only per AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails and are untouched by this diff.

⚠️ **The run's own two blind spots, answered rather than inherited:** ① the emitter-vs-inputs gap — the rule this diff carries is 「a declared live scalar key gets one form row」, and no page states that rule by its inputs, because no page states it at all (the card exists precisely because the population was never written down); ② the name-is-not-a-key hazard — none of the 45 keys is one of the seven ambiguous spellings the #19093 census names (`active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools`, `version`).

## Contract review

`9e6e78dd1e871028f1969863e87b20ceffd5e0a4`

Reviewed-by: `domain:spec` execution seat 5 (`session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`, seat post #19357)
Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER — at tier, so the clause-② judgement is made in-seat.

⚠️ **This comment was edited in place at 2026-09-22T07:07Z, for two reasons, both stated rather than quietly fixed.**

1. ⛔ **It named a model identifier.** AGENTS.md: 「no model identifier lands in a PR title or body, a comment, a changeset, a doc or a code comment」 — and a review of record IS a comment. The tier is named by its CONSTANT above, which is what the queue guard's reader wants and what the rule permits.
2. **It was anchored to `047f2917e`, and the head moved.** The delta between the two heads is **one commit, one file**: `.changeset/19331-scalar-form-rows.md`, whose `field.format` bullet was corrected (see 「What moved after the first record」 below). ⛔ No source file, no test, no assertion and no count moved, so every reading below stands on this head as taken.

⛔ Reviewed against the diff and `origin/main`, ⛔ not against the dev's report. The C6 record is owed on every round this lane delivers, `Clause-②` yes or no alike; this one reads **no**.

### Clause-② — NO, and the reason is structural

**Nothing in this diff can change the accept/reject verdict on any input.** Measured: the 18 changed files contain **zero** `*.zod.ts`. No schema, no `.describe()`, no export, no `package.json` `files[]` entry moves. `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY` is declared `Readonly<Record<string, FormView>>` — an opaque map whose row CONTENTS were never part of the declared surface, so a row landing inside it is not a surface widening under any reading of the clause.

What does move is the **form payload** `getMetaTypes()` serves and the translation keys `os i18n extract` walks — a published-bytes change, not an accept-set change. That is the pair the changeset grades: `@objectstack/spec` **minor**, `@objectstack/platform-objects` **patch**, `@objectstack/lint` **none** (its only change is a test). `skip-changeset` is ⛔ not available here.

### What this seat verified by counting, ⛔ not by reading the report

| claim | this seat's reading |
|---|---|
| 45 rows landed | **45** — counted by `field:` key across the ten `*.form.ts` patches: 1+1+2+19+6+1+4+9+1+1 |
| 90 i18n leaves | **90** — 45 `label:` + 45 `helpText:` per bundle; +180 lines = 45 × 4, identically in all four catalogs |
| the declared file surface expanded by 7 | **7** — 18 files − 10 `*.form.ts` − 1 changeset; `source-hashes.generated.ts` correctly absent, which is the provenance claim's own negative side |
| the lint pin moved by a measured 19 | 19 = 15 `field` + 4 others; 11 quoted-literal comparisons + 7 `in` gates + 1 bare `true` = 19; 19 + 26 = 45 — reconciles in both directions |
| the object-form pins moved by 10 and 2 | `advanced` 36 → 46 and open 94 → 96, matching object.form.ts's 5 `advanced` rows + `nameField` in `basics` |

**Three of the card's five example keys do not hold, re-measured here on `origin/main`:** `field.precision` is already offered (`field.form.ts:73`); `shortcutKey` has **0** occurrences repo-wide; `permission.license` is declared neither by `PermissionSetSchema` nor by `packages/spec/liveness/permission.json`. The population is **49**, of which **45** land and **4** are named.

**Copy口径 spot-checked against the schema that owns each key**, because a help text stating runtime behaviour is a claim: `ownership` (「absent → user」), `sharingModel` (「a CUSTOM object that omits it resolves to private」 — the qualifier is load-bearing: a **system** object defaults its org-wide sharing to public), `undoable` (`action.zod.ts:1320`), `app.hidden`, `nameField` (ADR-0079). All five hold.

### Two items were sent back before this record, ⛔ neither waved through

1. **A comment mis-attributed two leaves to this card.** `object-collapsed-sections-echo-decisions.test.ts` said 12 where the card brought 10, absorbing a 2-leaf shortfall that predates it. Fixed comment-only; `git diff --unified=0` filtered to `expect(` returns **0** changed assertions.
2. **What moved after the first record — a false claim on its way to npm.** The changeset said `field.format`'s liveness evidence 「contains no read of the key」. **Measured false by this seat:** `packages/spec/src/data/autonumber-format.ts:196-202` resolves `autonumberFormat` → **`format`** → the default, and `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts:5043-5051` calls it for every `autonumber` field (the SQL driver too). The read is TRANSITIVE, so grepping the cited file for the key could not find it whatever the truth was. The DECISION — no control for this key — is unchanged and stronger: it is one `z.string()` carrying an autonumber pattern, a date display style and a `describe` vocabulary (`email` / `phone`) nothing honours. Corrected in the changeset before it ships, and in this PR body.

### Main-branch risk, read rather than assumed

The class this seat caught on a sibling PR — a `.describe()` the console pins verbatim moving under a gate that is `skipped` on the PR and live on `main` — **has no analogue here**: the Console Pin Gate asks 「does the PINNED SHA still BUILD」 against this tree's `@objectstack/client`, and this diff touches no schema, no exported type and no describe. Zero `*.zod.ts` files is the whole argument.

### Filed out of this round, ⛔ by the seat, ⛔ not by the dev

#19677 (the object designer offers two formula return types `FieldSchema.returnType` refuses) · #19678 (`FormSelectOptionSchema.value` is a system identifier, so hyphenated and capitalised enum members are unspellable as option values) · #19679 (`field.format`'s vocabularies).

### Verdict

**ACCEPT**, on this head. CI reads 32 success / 3 skipped / 0 incomplete, latest-per-name. Not a governed surface, so no maintainer merge is owed; the two confirmations the 速读 asks for are the author's call at review, ⛔ not a gate on landing.
